metadata.title: Compress Repetition into a Pattern
metadata.description: Handle periodic sequences, alternating sums, consecutive even numbers, and scaled series.

content.text: Repeating sequences are about cycle length, not term-by-term listing. Reduce the position modulo the cycle length and map the remainder to the correct place in the cycle.
For consecutive even numbers, represent them as x,x+2,x+4,... . For scaled sums, factor out the common multiplier instead of recomputing the entire series.
Use pair cancellation in an alternating sum.
Whenever a sequence repeats or scales, search for the invariant first: cycle length, common difference, or common multiplier.
Now locate a distant term in a repeating sequence.
Finish with consecutive even numbers and a shifted block.
Nice. Sequence questions are now pattern-recognition problems rather than long calculations.
